conviction_note: The non-result. Management's July guide (core opex ~$58M, +~4bp NIM from the loan sale, swap-fee rebound, high-single-digit loan growth, 10-20% NPL resolution) gets mechanically to the $0.74-0.75 consensus. The out-of-company evidence offsets: Louisiana and Texas peers that have reported since show deposit costs rising after the September Fed hike and AOCI pressure on TBV (Investar TBV -2.3%), and a Lafayette peer fell 9.6% on CRE nonaccrual migration, against BFST's own guide for falling NPLs. The findings sum to 0.0 and p_up is 50; abs_move is held at 4.0, about the name's 3.85 median, because the Q4 integrated run-rate guide and credit are the lines that move it and peers moved large on credit.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus EPS about $0.74-0.75 (Benzinga $0.74, revenue $93.3M, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/BFST/earnings-forecasts; Earnings Whispers $0.75, https://www.earningswhispers.com/epsdetails/BFST; Chartmill shows $0.77, https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/BFST/earnings). Two sources roughly agree at $0.74-0.75. Q2 core EPS was $0.71 against $0.70 consensus. Company guide (Q2 call, 2026-07-23): core noninterest expense 'closer to 58' in Q3 and 57 in Q4, +~4bp NIM from the Progressive loan sale, high-single-digit annualized loan growth in Q3 and Q4, NPL resolutions of 10-20% in Q3, year-end NPLs ~$50M (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-23-business-first-bancshares-inc-stock/).
positioning_check: No usable option chain: ATM legs are not two-sided, so there is no skew and no implied move. Put/call OI is 393 of 394 total, which is meaningless at that size. Short interest is 846.9K shares, 2.60% of float, 3.5 days to cover, as of the 2026-08-21 settlement (https://equibles.com/stocks/bfst/shortinterest). CurvedTrading had 1.1M shares and 2.61 days on 2026-06-30 (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/bfst/); I found no October settlement. This is not a crowded short. The stock is 1.15% below its 52-week high, +3.4% over 20 days and +1.9% over 5 days, with 20-day realised vol of 15%. All five analysts rate it Buy, with an average PT of $34.90 against $31.91 spot (https://www.investing.com/equities/business-first-consensus-estimates). Expectations are full but not stretched.

findings.finding: The Q2 call guide maps onto a Q3 above Q2's $0.71 core EPS. Core opex is guided to ~$58M, against $58.4M core in Q2. The Progressive loan sale adds ~4bp of NIM, on a Q2 NIM of 3.73% GAAP / 3.68% ex-accretion. Swap fees are guided back to Q2 levels, the loan-sale proceeds are redeployed half in Q3, and loan growth is high-single-digit annualized. That path lands at about the $0.74-0.75 consensus, so it is inside the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (in line, +0.01 beat, NIM +8bp) bought +2.26%; Q1 2026 core $0.73 with an interest reversal sold -4.42%; Q3 2025 +6.88%. Small beats have been bought modestly.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced. Consensus moved from Q2's $0.71 to $0.74-0.75, which is what the guide implies. Only execution against the guide is open, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: The Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001624322/000162432226000032/exhibit991_earningsrelease.htm) gives the Q2 starting levels and the 'strong second half' language. Same company, different document.

findings.finding: Rates rose hard in Q3. The Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00% in mid-September, and the 10-year reached ~5.1% by 2026-09-23 (Hancock Whitney's Q3 commentary cites +82bp). Investar, the closest-sized Louisiana peer, reported on 10-22 that AOCI widened from $(37.8)M to $(53.2)M and TBV/share fell 2.3% QoQ. BFST carries $1.04B of AFS at fair value with a $45.4M gross unrealized loss and AOCI of $(35.8)M at 6/30. A comparable mark would take roughly $10-15M (~$0.35-0.45/share) off TBV against ~$0.55 of retained quarterly earnings. TBV is therefore likely flat to slightly down, where Q2 added +$0.43.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No BFST print in the baseline turned visibly on TBV/AOCI. Bank TBV marks from rates are usually looked through when the whole sector shares them.
findings.why_not_priced: Investar printed one session before this baseline was sealed, so few previews will have marked BFST's TBV for the Q3 rate move. The stock sits 1% from its 52-week high, which is what you would see if a TBV dip had not been discounted. It is small because it is sector-wide and non-cash.
findings.independence: This is a proxy: the transmission is peer AOCI applied to BFST's own 10-Q AFS book (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001624322/000162432226000037/bfst-20260630.htm). FNB reported its AOCI drag widening from $0.29 to $0.53/share in Q3 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000037808/000003780826000027/fnbex991earningsreleaseq32.htm).

findings.finding: Credit is the line Gulf South peers are being punished on. Home Bancorp (Lafayette LA, with Houston exposure) reported on 10-19 a credit-driven EPS miss of $1.28 against $1.51 consensus, after six relationships ($19.5M) went nonaccrual and CRE nonaccruals more than doubled; the stock fell 9.6%. BFST enters with NPLs at 1.26% of loans ($84.1M) and NPAs at 1.23% of assets. It has guided that Q3 resolves 10-20% of NPLs and that NPLs reach ~$50M by year-end. The peer migration risk and BFST's own resolution guide point opposite ways, so this nets to a small negative with a wide band.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 NPLs fell from 1.53% to 1.26% and the stock rose +2.26%. Q1 2026 had an interest-income reversal on credit and the stock fell -4.42%.
findings.why_not_priced: BFST is 1% from its high after the peer's -9.6%, so the market has not marked BFST down on the read-through. Consistent with that, BFST's own guide calls for falling NPLs, which consensus presumably assumes. The asymmetry is that a missed resolution guide on a 1.26% NPL book is punished more than a hit is rewarded.
findings.independence: This is a peer proxy. BFST's guide is the counter-evidence (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-23-business-first-bancshares-inc-stock/). Investar's NPLs also rose, from 0.63% to 0.70% (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001602658/000143774926033291/ex_1008963.htm). Hancock Whitney's nonaccruals rose $19.6M (https://finviz.com/news/405180/hancock-whitney-edges-past-consensus-but-misses-whisper-as-raised-nii-guidance-comes-at-a-capital-cost).

findings.finding: The Progressive core conversion was scheduled for August 10, 2026. Management said material synergies appear only after conversion, with expenses lower in Q4 as cost saves (~$11M annualized at announcement) are recognized and Q4 core opex 'closer to 57'. This print is therefore the first chance to firm a fully integrated Q4 run-rate and the 1.25% exit-Q4 ROA target. Q3 itself carries conversion one-offs that are excluded from core.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025, when the Progressive deal and its synergy story were fresh, the stock rose +6.88%. No print has yet carried a post-conversion run-rate.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether conversion went cleanly is unknown publicly: I found no 8-K, press release or customer-complaint coverage after August 10. If a clean conversion were known, Q4 estimates would already embed the full cost saves. Management itself hedged ROA ('not automatic'), so the Q4 bar is soft in either direction.
findings.independence: The Q1 2026 release says synergies come only after the Q3 conversion (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001624322/000162432226000024/exhibit991_earningsrelease.htm). Same company.

findings.finding: Q2 deposits fell $229.4M (-12.3% annualized), driven by commercial money market and brokered outflows. Management said balances were 'already beginning to move back in materially over the course of July' and that brokered CDs reprice lower in Q3-Q4. Peers that have reported show flat-to-down deposits (Investar -1.0% QoQ, Home Bancorp core deposits -$28.3M) and rising deposit costs after the hike (Hancock Whitney +12bp, Third Coast interest-bearing +8bp, Investar +1bp). A Q3 deposit rebound with stable costs would be a positive; costs following the peers would offset it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 deposit decline came with a +2.26% reaction, so the market looked through it.
findings.why_not_priced: Neither the July inflow nor the post-hike deposit-cost move is public for BFST. Peers point both ways, so this nets to zero.

findings.finding: Insiders sold steadily after the Q2 print and bought nothing that I found. Director George W. Cummings III sold 10,000 shares at ~$31.87 (Aug 3), 10,000 at $31.78 (Aug 18), 3,235 at $31.80 (Aug 19) and 4,200 at $31.27 (Aug 21). Director Joseph Vernon Johnson sold in late July, and EVP Saundra Strong sold 1,000 at ~$31.98 on Aug 5. The 8-K list since July shows twelve Form 4s and nine Form 144/144-As. The dollars are small: about $1M disclosed for Cummings.
findings.why_not_priced: The sales are public, but they cluster at $31-32, today's price. Insiders selling into the level the stock now sits at, near its high, is mildly informative. It is sized small because the amounts are small and no 10b5-1 status is known.

baseline_tension: Nothing here cuts against the baseline. There is no skew, the run-up is modest, the stock sits near its high under all-Buy coverage, and the evidence offsets to zero. Peers moving large on credit argue for a normal-to-full absolute move, not a direction.
lessons_applied: Lesson 3 (own caveat reaches the number): the credit finding's own text says BFST's resolution guide points the other way from the peer read-through, so it moved from -0.3 to -0.2.

Lesson 3 / core step 4: the deposit finding is balanced by its own peer evidence (Investar's NIM up against Hancock Whitney's costs up), so it moved from +0.2 to 0.0. p_up moved from 48 to 50, so the scaled number is 0.
Lesson 6: the bar is sourced to two roughly agreeing estimates ($0.74/$0.75) plus the company's guide. No cap was needed, and the reported-quarter finding is labelled as inside the guide.
Lessons 5 and 7 left the rest standing: the peer proxies were already small; short interest is 2.6% of float, not crowded; there is no skew to defy.
